not_verified: No model/native execution or postflight RPC was repeated.
Client counters/body hashes are not independent model-server invocation attestation or full remote wire capture.
Native HTTP here is official FastAPI TestClient ASGI in isolated processes; not a deployed physical TCP system.
Generic scoring predictions contain no model request_payload; their zero request-marker score is not independent input-exposure verification.
Registered literal/decoded-marker checks do not establish complete semantic or inference privacy.
Snapshot content hashes were checked; original HMAC validity, adversarial rollback and distributed/fresh online revocation were not independently proven.
Existing original files are internally consistent; checksums cannot authenticate a coordinated forged runner/artifact history.
One exposed synthetic story group with repeated conditions is not independent holdout acceptance or proof of 100% generalization.
Changes between literal-token and Flat-ID runs do not isolate every nuisance factor, including request nonces or model runtime variability.
Native G confinement rejects and gateway authorization rejects are different measurements and are reported separately.
